instruction.default: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query

semantics.mask: PNG at original owned image dimensions; no interpolated class IDs
semantics.structured: optional second multi output describes every present pixel ID; unique IDs and counts sum to width*height

semantics.coordinates: zero-based input row and column indices
semantics.table: distinct columns; all rows have exactly the column count
semantics.generated: generative answers carry no claimed cell grounding

semantics.boxes: normalized xyxy in original owned page image, one per OCR word
semantics.answer: contiguous inclusive OCR word span; box is its union
semantics.ocr: caller-provided text; no implicit external OCR process

semantics.type: local interest points; no human joint-label semantics

semantics.sampling: uniform presentation-time sampling over selected clip
semantics.temporal: one ordered joint video inference, never image voting
one ordered native video sequence with timestamps

semantics.segments: ordered nonoverlapping speech intervals, start < end

semantics.document: one owned page image; ordered native page-token vectors
semantics.queries: same order as input; native query augmentation retained; padding removed
semantics.vectors: 128-, 320- or 4096-dimensional unit vectors; native width declared by the profile; rounded to six decimal places; no token or dimension truncation
semantics.score: For each query vector, take the maximum cosine dot product with page vectors; sum these maxima for sum-max-cosine or average them for mean-max-cosine. Recomputed from returned vectors; not a probability.
semantics.limits: Up to 256 page tokens and 64 query tokens; 4096-dimensional outputs are bounded to 144 page tokens and 48 tokens per query. Aggregate JSON result: 900 KiB for narrow vectors, 12 MiB for 4096 dimensions.

semantics.conditioning: no text prompt or hidden synthetic prompt
semantics.sampling: one native unconditional sample; geometry must be honored or narrowed

semantics.grounding: one owned audio input and instruction jointly condition the native decoder; ASR-only execution cannot satisfy this contract

semantics.operations: enhance/separate/encode require audio; voice conversion also requires reference audio; decode requires codes; vocode requires spectrogram
semantics.authority: a signed profile narrows operation and sample rate to its native binding
semantics.outputs: encode returns codes; separate returns bounded native stems; other operations return owned PCM audio

semantics.grounding: owned source fields exactly match explicit inputMode; signed profiles narrow input/output modes to native combinations
semantics.audio: audio output requires complete native talker/codec/vocoder; thinker-only execution is text-only

semantics.conditioning: image and prompt both condition the native temporal graph

semantics.timebase: source presentation time; editing preserves selected clip order and mask alignment
semantics.controls: restoration rejects prompt and masks; edit requires prompt; native geometry and frame limits are narrowed by the profile

semantics.features: ordered distinct columns; rectangular rows; numeric cells are numbers/null, categorical cells strings/null
semantics.training: one target per training row; query rows never contain targets; no cross-request fitted state
semantics.prediction: one output per query in input order; classification uses explicit unique class order and normalized probabilities

semantics.time: timestamps are strictly increasing and regular at declared frequency; forecast begins after final context timestamp
semantics.covariates: past covariates align with context; future covariates align with horizon; paired matrices have equal column count
semantics.quantiles: requested levels increasing; values ordered without crossing; no fabricated uncertainty or repeated point estimates

semantics.confidence: native heatmap score, not a probability
semantics.order: same pose order as input boxes; unique labeled joint IDs
